description: This file contains unit tests for the UtilProperties utility class within the Apache OFBiz framework. It verifies the parsing of XML resource files with different xml:lang attribute formats.

classes.name: UtilPropertiesTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the UtilProperties XML parsing functionality with different xml:lang attribute formats.

methods.name: testReadXmlLangOldStyle
methods.description: Tests that XML properties with old-style xml:lang attribute (en_AU) are correctly parsed.

methods.name: testReadXmlLangNewStyle
methods.description: Tests that XML properties with correct-style xml:lang attribute (en-AU) are correctly parsed.

methods.name: xmlToProperties
methods.description: Helper method to generate XML data with specified separator and parse it into Properties.
